headers.name: actual_boundary_block_normal_form
headers.header:
theorem actual_boundary_block_normal_form
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (code : N.BlobPort b ↪ Nat) (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ) (xs : List (M).OpenedTip),
      IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧
      (∀ (k : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip),
        (OG).OrientedQuartet k ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ¬((θ a<θ d ∧ θ d<θ c ∧ θ c<θ e) ∨
          (θ d<θ a ∧ θ a<θ e ∧ θ e<θ c))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, θ a<θ c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
          (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, a≠c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        Nanuq.Restriction.CyclicGap (xs.map (fun t => code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)))
          (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a)) (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a))) ∧
      (∃ k base dup, k≤1 ∧ base.Nodup ∧
        (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t))=
          Nanuq.Restriction.blocks base dup)

headers.name: exists_distinct_end_break
headers.header:
theorem exists_distinct_end_break (xs : List Nat)
    (hcount : ∀ x, xs.count x≤2)
    (hdist : ∃ a∈xs, ∃ b∈xs, a≠b) :
    ∃ k first middle last, k≤1 ∧
      xs.rotate k=first::(middle++[last]) ∧ first≠last

headers.name: exhaustive_map_count
headers.header:
theorem exhaustive_map_count {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (xs : List T)
    (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hall : ∀ t, t∈xs) (lab : T → Nat) (y : Nat) :
    (xs.map lab).count y=(Finset.univ.filter (fun t => lab t=y)).card

headers.name: finite_label_blocks
headers.header:
theorem finite_label_blocks {T L : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype L]
    (xs : List T) (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hall : ∀ t, t∈xs)
    (label : T → L) (hsurj : Function.Surjective label)
    (code : L → Nat) (hinj : Function.Injective code)
    (hmult : ∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => label t=x)).card≤2)
    (htwo : 2≤Fintype.card L)
    (hgaps : ∀ a c, a≠c → label a=label c →
      CyclicGap (xs.map (fun t => code (label t))) (code (label a)) (code (label a))) :
    ∃ k base dup, k≤1 ∧ base.Nodup ∧
      (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => code (label t))=blocks base dup

headers.name: mem_blocks_iff
headers.header:
theorem mem_blocks_iff (base : List Nat) (dup : Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) :
    x∈blocks base dup ↔ x∈base

headers.name: blocks_congr
headers.header:
theorem blocks_congr (base : List Nat) (d e : Nat → Bool)
    (h : ∀ x∈base, d x=e x) : blocks base d=blocks base e

theorem linearGap_remove_head {x y : Nat} {xs : List Nat} (hne : x≠y)
    (h : LinearGap (x::xs) y y) : LinearGap xs y y

theorem linear_blocks_factor (xs : List Nat)
    (hcount : ∀ x, xs.count x≤2)
    (hpairs : ∀ x, xs.count x=2 → LinearGap xs x x) :

headers.name: cyclicGap_rotate_one

theorem cyclicGap_rotate_one (xs : List Nat) (a b : Nat)

headers.name: cyclicGap_linear_of_distinct_ends
headers.header:
theorem cyclicGap_linear_of_distinct_ends (first last x : Nat) (middle : List Nat)
    (hne : first≠last) (h : CyclicGap (first::(middle++[last])) x x) :
